{"command": "if [ -z "${OGR_SECRET_1}" ]; then
  echo "OGR_SECRET_1 is not set in this shell." >&2
  exit 1
fi

tmp=$(mktemp)
git clone "https://oauth2:${OGR_SECRET_1}@github.com/acme/infra.git" >"$tmp" 2>&1
status=$?
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
  printf '%s\n' "${line//${OGR_SECRET_1}/***}"
done < "$tmp"
rm -f "$tmp"
exit "$status""}
